purpose: One add-cities-compatible plan that preserves the final wave-two destination slugs while enforcing honest city/region grouping, raw bbox containment and deterministic nearest-centre inference.

policy.raw_bbox_gate: Every retained coordinate must be inside the declared raw bbox, without relying on the build's typo-tolerance margin.
policy.inference_gate: After all proposed entries are added, tools/model.cityForPoint must return the row's explicit city slug; overlapping expanded bboxes are resolved by the nearest bbox centre.
policy.semantic_gate: Use an existing city/metro or intentionally broad existing region when its page label honestly describes the destination; otherwise add a tight named city/town or a genuinely geographic region.
policy.region_flag_gate: region:1 is reserved for wide islands, counties, forests, valleys, parks and dispersed rural municipalities; a compact named city, town or village remains a normal registry row.
policy.bbox_update_gate: Widen an existing bbox only when its page remains the honest destination label. No such update is necessary in this run.

corrections_already_reflected_in_final_d.reason: A Jacksonville city page is more exact than the prior Florida state-region assignment and avoids the Georgia overlap at the state boundary.
Johns Island is the objective's actual island landscape; the existing Charleston raw bbox does not contain the tree.
The tree stands in Santa María del Tule, not Oaxaca city's raw bbox.
Adding Virginia Beach made the broad Virginia assignment infer to Virginia Beach; a tight Hampton entry restores both geographic meaning and deterministic inference.
